summary: The Swift client can talk to the member's trusted local Unix socket as the person, so a desktop app on the person's own Mac needs no pairing or bearer credential

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No rules, digest or coordination changes; the daemon's local person trust is unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Additive Swift client API: FractalClient(localSocketPath:person:client:traceContext:messagesPaging:) carries every request and WebSocket stream over the local Unix socket with x-st3-person. The existing fabricLoopbackURL initializer and its URLSession behaviour are unchanged. The daemon already served /v1/client/ on fractal.sock to a local person, so every supported daemon works with it.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; apps can switch back to a paired fabricLoopbackURL client at any time.
